## How this work is cited

Passages inside Leviathan are identified by part and chapter (e.g. i.13). Written in English, with a later Latin version by Hobbes himself that differs in places. The chapter numbers are the standard reference.

## The work in Thomas Hobbes’s thought

Thomas Hobbes (1588–1679) was the English philosopher of absolutist sovereignty and mechanistic psychology, author of Leviathan (1651). Tutor and associate of aristocratic families, he weathered Civil War exile in Paris and scientific debate with Boyle’s circle. [More on Thomas Hobbes](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/thomas-hobbes) .
